Procedure Name.cell: EPMA-WDS Carbonate+Silicate/Oxide Composition, Bennu (Smithsonian, JEOL 8530 F+ Hyperprobe)
Procedure Name.value: EPMA-WDS Carbonate+Silicate/Oxide Composition, Bennu (Smithsonian, JEOL 8530 F+ Hyperprobe)

Laboratory.cell: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History
Laboratory.value: Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History

Coupled Technique(s).cell: SEM-EDS (NHM London; Smithsonian; JSC); TEM-EDS/EELS; FIB-SEM; ToF-SIMS; XRD; XANES
Coupled Technique(s).value: SEM-EDS (NHM London; Smithsonian; JSC); TEM-EDS/EELS; FIB-SEM; ToF-SIMS; XRD; XANES

Target Material.cell: carbonate; magnetite; olivine — 'Carbonate analyses were run at 15 kV and 10 nA ...; analyses of magnetite and olivine were run under the same conditions' (p.7)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Ir-coated specimens mounted on Ir-coated Parafilm
Sample Preparation Method.value: Ir-coated specimens mounted on Ir-coated Parafilm

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Phase > Analysis point — "Electron microprobe analysis was conducted on Ir-coated specimens" (p.7); results are reported by phase, e.g. "the calcite has near-end member composition (4 mol.% or less MgCO3 and FeCO3)" (p.2)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: N — the paper names the phases it analysed (see `Sampling Unit Type`) but states no rule for choosing the individual units

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Optical microscopy, then FE-SEM/EDS characterisation — particles "were characterized using a JEOL 7600 F FE-SEM equipped with a 170-mm2 SSD type Oxford Instruments Ultim Max EDS detector", and "Following initial documentation by optical microscopy, samples were sputter coated" (p.7); the SEM work is reported for the JSC facility, the microprobe work for this laboratory

Instrument Model.cell: JXA-8530F Plus (stated as "JEOL 8530 F+ Hyperprobe Field Emission Electron Probe Microanalyzer")
Instrument Model.value: JXA-8530F Plus (stated as "JEOL 8530 F+ Hyperprobe Field Emission Electron Probe Microanalyzer")

WDS Spectrometer Configuration.cell: LIFL (Fe Ka, Mn Ka); TAPL (Mg Ka); PETL (Ca Ka) — partial; full config N
WDS Spectrometer Configuration.value: LIFL (Fe Ka, Mn Ka); TAPL (Mg Ka); PETL (Ca Ka)

Beam Mode.cell: N — only spot sizes are given

Beam Diameter.cell: carbonate: 5 µm; magnetite, olivine: 1 µm — 'with an analytical spot size of 5 µm' (carbonates); 'Analyses were conducted at 15kV and 10nA, with an analytical spot size of 1µm' (the magnetite and olivine sentence)

Target Species.cell: Fe, Mn, Mg, Ca — the carbonate analyses, named with their crystals; the elements of the magnetite and olivine analyses are not named

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: Fe, Mn, Mg, Ca — all determined. "Carbonate analyses were run at 15 kV and 10 nA, with an analytical spot size of 5 µm. Fe and Mn were analysed using a LIFL crystal, Mg using a TAPL crystal and Ca using a PETL crystal" (p.7)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Carbonate end-member composition (mol%: MgCO3, FeCO3, MnCO3 — calcite is "near-end member composition (4 mol.% or less MgCO3 and FeCO3; 0.1 mol.% or less MnCO3)", p.2); phase identifications (nominal)

Diffracting Crystal.cell: Fe, Mn: LIFL; Mg: TAPL; Ca: PETL — p.7

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — compositions are reported by phase with no contributing count and no selection rule stated

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: N — standards are named without their elements: magnetite (USNM 114887), calcite (USNM 13621), dolomite (USNM 10057), siderite (R-2460) and rhodonite (carbonates); chromite (USNM 117075), ilmenite (USNM 96189), magnetite (USNM 114887), manganite (USNM 157872), bytownite (R-2912), forsterite (P140), San Carlos olivine (USNM 111312/444) and Springwater olivine (USNM 2566) (magnetite and olivine)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: calcite, dolomite, rhodochrosite, magnetite, San Carlos olivine, Springwater olivine — carbonates: calcite, dolomite and rhodochrosite; magnetite and olivine: magnetite, San Carlos olivine and Springwater olivine (p.7)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: McCoy et al. 2025, Nature 637:320-325 — Bennu evaporites. Protocol 1 of 2: Smithsonian Institution JEOL 8530 F+ Hyperprobe (Field Emission). Ir-coated specimens mounted on Ir-coated Parafilm. Carbonate analyses: 15 kV, 10 nA, 5 µm spot; LIFL (Fe,Mn), TAPL (Mg), PETL (Ca). Silicate/oxide analyses: 15 kV, 10 nA, 1 µm spot; broader standard suite. Both primary and secondary standard suites fully documented with USNM catalog numbers. Acquisition software and matrix correction method N. WDS not explicitly stated in text (crystal designations LIFL/TAPL/PETL confirm WDS use).
